text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - Pakistan bought 500,000 tonnes of white wheat for August 11-September 10 shipment, the Pakistan embassy said. The purchase included 200,000 tonnes U.S. white wheat, 250,000 tonnes Australian wheat and 50,000 tonnes Canadian.

WHEAT/SOY SALE - A Philippine flour mill bought 22,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 15,000 tonnes of soybeans for August delivery. It bought the spring wheat with 14 percent protein content at $3.82 per bushel FOB and the soybeans at $7.52 per bushel FOB. The purchase was made on Friday night.
CORN/SOY TENDER - Taiwan is expected to tender for up to 108,000 tonnes corn and 54,000 tonnes soybeans this week.
- State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on July 29 for a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 12,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans, traders said.
WHEAT TENDER - Morocco was seeking a total of 120,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat to be delivered in August and September, European traders said. Offers were due August 4.
- The CCC was seeking on July 30 up to 3,530 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Honduras. Shipment period was set Aug 15-Sept 5.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was seeking on July 29 up to 4,100 tonnes of U.S. Hard Red Winter wheat for donation to Bosnia. Shipment period was slated for Aug 15-Sept 5.

- CCC was seeking up to 6,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Armenia and 6,500 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for donation to Georgia. Shipment was slated for Aug 20-Sept 8. Offers are due August 5.

- Armenia was also seeking about 1,000 to 1,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better HRW wheat in bulk under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Delivery dates were set for Aug 20-Sept 8 and offers were due Aug 5.

- VEGOIL TENDERS - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking on August 19 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

- El Salvador said it was seeking 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,250 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be received by July 29 and remain valid until July 30. The shipment dates for both commodities were slated for September 10-25.

VEGOIL, RICE, FLOUR TENDERS - The CCC was seeking a total of 10,470 tonnes of rice, vegetable oil, sunflower oil and all purpose flour for donation to Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Bosnia. Offers for all commodities were due August 6. It was was tendering 1,500 tonnes rice in 50 kg bags for Kyrgyzstan, 750 tonnes vegetable oil and another 1,450 tonnes vegetable oil, packaged in plastic bottles for Kyrgyzstan. It also included 2,695 tonnes of sunflower oil for Georgia and 1,250 tonnes sunflower oil for Bosnia. It also comprised 1,075 tonnes all purpose flour for Georgia and 1,750 tonnes flour for Bosnia. Shipping period was set for Aug 21-Sept 5.
MARKET TALK - China was unlikely to buy soybeans at current prices, although they may well have been making enquiries in the market, traders said on Tuesday.

... European grain traders said they expected Jordan to come to the market in August and buy some 100,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat of the hard red winter variety. Amman has not called any tender but traders say there is a rumour of a tender towards August 12. "There is nothing official for the moment, but we are expecting them," a trader said.
... USDA said it was offering $35 million to Ukraine to aid sale of U.S. grains, oilseeds, protein meal, vegetable oils and other ag products in fiscal 1997.
